senses.en: a pilot
examples: Amy Johnson was a pioneering [[aviator]] who made record-breaking flights to Australia and South Africa in the 1930s.

senses.en: (pl. aircraft) a plane or other vehicle that can fly
examples: Commercial airlines often find it cheaper to park their [[aircraft]] at a storage facility than at an airport.

senses.en: popular, esp. for a short period of time
examples: Reading has become the [[fashionable]] educational activity for summer months with schools and libraries running reading challenges.

senses.zh: 无目的的；无意义的；无价值的；不重要的
senses.en: having no purpose or importance and therefore not worth doing or having
examples: He said a few [[meaningless]] words to his hostess and looked around the room.

senses.en: designed to be useful rather than beautiful or attractive
examples: Their tips provide guidance to anyone looking to set up a smart and [[functional]] workspace at home.

senses.zh: 装饰物，小配件（如手袋、皮带、珠宝等）
senses.en: sth. such as a bag, belt, or jewelry that you wear or carry because it is attractive
examples: This store offers a wide range of clothing, shoes, and [[accessories]] for men, women, and children.
[[Accessories]] such as a carrying case and a battery recharger are free with the purchase of a cell phone.

senses.en: sth. such as a piece of equipment or a decoration that is not necessary, but that makes a machine, car, room, etc. more useful or more attractive
examples: This store offers a wide range of clothing, shoes, and [[accessories]] for men, women, and children.
[[Accessories]] such as a carrying case and a battery recharger are free with the purchase of a cell phone.

senses.en: (fml.) clothes
examples: They specialize in the supply of sports [[apparel]] such as sweatshirts and baseball caps to retail markets.

senses.zh: 不受注意的；未被注意的
senses.en: (fml.) not noticed
examples: There are many brave and admirable social workers doing [[unremarked]] work across the nation.

senses.en: (usu. passive) live in an area
examples: The world's largest iceberg would possibly crash into an island [[populated]] by penguins and seals.

senses.en: the act of including sb. / sth. in a larger group or set, or the fact of being included in one
examples: Evidence is needed to prove that the word has been used in a variety of different sources before it can be considered for [[inclusion]] in one of the dictionaries.

senses.en: very
examples: She is planning to travel to [[distinctly]] different destinations in pursuit of happiness and vision.
I [[distinctly]] remember asking him not to tell her about the new sales figures.

senses.en: clearly
examples: She is planning to travel to [[distinctly]] different destinations in pursuit of happiness and vision.
I [[distinctly]] remember asking him not to tell her about the new sales figures.

senses.zh: 为···编目录；把···列入目录中
senses.en: vt.make a complete list of all the things in a group
examples: The works came to light during the 1950s, when they were [[catalogued]] in the museum's collection.
She uses an online [[catalogue]] to search for items by price or country, instead of the hard copies traditionally taken to auctions (拍卖会).

senses.en: n. a complete list of things that you can look at, buy, or use, for example in a library or at an art show
examples: The works came to light during the 1950s, when they were [[catalogued]] in the museum's collection.
She uses an online [[catalogue]] to search for items by price or country, instead of the hard copies traditionally taken to auctions (拍卖会).

senses.zh: 策划组织（展览、表演、音乐会等）
senses.en: choose and organize the art, music, objects, etc. for an exhibition, show, concert, etc.
examples: Focused on artwork inspired by nature, this exhibition is [[curated]] by four high school students.

senses.zh: 毫无某物；完全没有某物
senses.en: (fml.) (be ~ of sth.) completely lacking in sth.
examples: Milly is the most serious person I know — her stories are always completely [[devoid]] of humor.

senses.en: relating to or having an effect on the emotions
examples: Studies in this area investigate how objects or messages can arouse [[affective]] reactions.

senses.zh: （尤指在石头或硬币表面）雕刻，印制，题写
senses.en: carefully cut, print, or write words on sth., esp. on the surface of a stone or coin
examples: She signed the book and [[inscribed]] the words "with grateful thanks" on it.

senses.en: clear enough or definite enough to be easily seen or noticed
examples: These fragments provide [[tangible]] evidence for how the city has changed since the 18th century.

senses.en: (fml.) combine and form one single group, substance, etc.
examples: His sporting and literary interests [[coalesced]] admirably in his writing about climbing.

senses.en: (AmE fiber)1)
a short piece of thread that has been sewn into a piece of cloth, or the action of the thread going into and out of the cloth
examples: You'd better put a [[stitch]] in the corner of the pocket to keep it in place.

senses.en: the feeling people have that they are members of a group in society and that they share particular qualities with other members of that group
examples: Human beings have a need for both independence and [[connectedness]].

senses.zh: 极其贵重的；极其重要的
senses.en: extremely valuable or important
examples: Her knowledge and experience would make her a [[priceless]] asset to the team.

senses.en: the act of preventing sth. from being lost, wasted, damaged or destroyed
examples: The project includes the [[conservation]] of 200 paintings, 15,000 books and quantities of furniture, ceramics and textiles.
China is one of the few places in the world where the elephant population is growing thanks to extensive [[conservation]] efforts.

senses.en: the protection of natural things such as animals, plants, and forests to prevent them from being spoiled or destroyed
examples: The project includes the [[conservation]] of 200 paintings, 15,000 books and quantities of furniture, ceramics and textiles.
China is one of the few places in the world where the elephant population is growing thanks to extensive [[conservation]] efforts.

senses.zh: 将（图书馆、博物馆等的新书、新展品）登记入册
senses.en: record the addition of a new item to a library, museum, etc.
examples: Objects will be accepted and [[accessioned]] into the museum's collections when these conditions are met.

senses.zh: 有责任的；有义务的；必须履行的
senses.en: (fml.) (~ upon / on sb. ) necessary as part of sb's duty
examples: It is [[incumbent]] upon parents to control what their children watch on TV.

senses.en: (fml.) sb. who guards or protects sth.
examples: These oral historians were the [[guardians]] of traditional values and the teachers of lessons about the natural world.
The girl's parents or [[guardians]] must give their consent before she has the operation.

senses.en: sb. who is legally responsible for looking after sb. else's child, esp. after the child's parents have died
examples: These oral historians were the [[guardians]] of traditional values and the teachers of lessons about the natural world.
The girl's parents or [[guardians]] must give their consent before she has the operation.

senses.en: a book that you put photographs, stamps, etc. in
examples: We've put the best wedding photos into an [[album]] — do you want to see them?
The singer talked about the inspiration behind the creation of each track from his newly released [[album]].

senses.en: a group of songs or pieces of music on a CD, tape, etc.
examples: We've put the best wedding photos into an [[album]] — do you want to see them?
The singer talked about the inspiration behind the creation of each track from his newly released [[album]].

senses.en: in a way of happening or developing in a natural and continuous process
examples: The company has been growing [[organically]] over the past few years.
There is firm evidence that [[organically]] grown crops are healthier to eat than conventional ones.

senses.zh: 不使用化肥地；有机地；绿色地
senses.en: in a way of growing food without using artificial chemicals
examples: The company has been growing [[organically]] over the past few years.
There is firm evidence that [[organically]] grown crops are healthier to eat than conventional ones.

senses.en: spread over a wide area or over a long period of time
examples: The higher cost of providing full services to a [[scattered]] community cannot be ignored.

senses.zh: （有拉门、搁板或抽屉的）储藏柜，陈列柜
senses.en: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves or drawers, used for storing or showing things
(festivities) things such as drinking, eating, or dancing that are done to celebrate a special occasion
examples: This year's [[festivities]] included fireworks, light shows and a live concert at King International Stadium.

senses.zh: 不同寻常；独特；独一无二
senses.en: the quality of being unusually good, special or the only one of its kind
examples: It is the [[uniqueness]] of her painting style for which she has been remembered over the past decades.

senses.en: a long thin string of cotton, silk, etc. used to sew or weave cloth
the act or process of repeating
examples: Companies should focus on customer experiences and strive to improve those experiences through constant [[iteration]].

senses.zh: 有目的地；有决心地；果断地
senses.en: with a clear aim or purpose, determinedly
examples: Upon hearing these words, she began walking slowly but [[purposefully]] toward the bridge.

senses.zh: 将某物存起来或藏起来
senses.en: store or hide sth.
examples: Every member of the family can now [[tuck]] away either £9 or £18 a month in one of these savings plans.

senses.en: in the state of existing
examples: That's why there are tens of thousands of start-ups in [[existence]] today.

english: it is incumbent upon / on sb. to do sth.

senses.zh: 做某事是某人的职务（责任）
senses.en: it is sb's duty or responsibility to do sth.
examples: It is [[incumbent]] upon all users of this equipment to familiarize themselves with the safety procedure.

senses.en: die — use this when you want to avoid saying the word "die"
examples: Stephen Hawking, who is known for his groundbreaking work with black holes and relativity, [[passed]] away at the age of 76.

senses.zh: 马里奥 • 梅西纳（人名）
